metadata.method: Re-anchor each simplified municipal polygon from display coordinates to its stored real representative lon/lat, using a common scale inferred from Okinawa-main-island features; repair polygon validity with Shapely buffer(0).
metadata.accuracy_note: This is a real-distance placement approximation, not an authoritative administrative boundary export. For cartographic/legal precision, replace geometry with MLIT National Land Numerical Information N03 and keep the same municipality_code property.
